study.title: Deep Learning-Based Weed Detection Using UAV Images: A Comparative Study

models_tested: x 5 backbones: VGG16, ResNet50, DenseNet121, EfficientNetB0, MobileNetV2

dataset.name: CoFly-WeedDB (public dataset; cotton field, Greece; Krestenitsi et al.)
dataset.note: Public dataset (zenodo.org/record/6697343): imagery captured with DJI Phantom Pro 4 over a cotton field in Greece at 5 m flight height; 1280x720 RGB; patch-based 256x256 (patches >97% background removed) -> 786 patches (628 train / 158 test; 1884 augmented training samples in D2). Classes: background + 3 weed species (Johnson grass, field bindweed, purslane); heavily imbalanced (purslane only 0.27e6 px). uav_collected=false: public benchmark, not collected by the study authors.

mIoU.quote: Ef­ficientNetB0 combined with UNet produces a mean IoU of 56.21%
mIoU.ambiguity: Multi-class (4-class) task, augmented dataset D2, best config UNet+EfficientNetB0. Class IoU: background 0.8809, Johnson grass 0.4478, bindweed 0.4673, purslane 0.4531. Binary-task best (SegNet+DenseNet121) mIoU 0.6756.

mPA.ambiguity: Overall accuracy = 0.8897 reported under the 'Acc.' column (equals Recall in their tables); captured under PA.

F1.quote: imparting Precision (88.20%), Recall (88.97%), F1-score (88.24%) and mean Intersection of Union (56.21%)
F1.ambiguity: Macro-averaged F1 over 4 classes for UNet+EfficientNetB0 multi-class task on D2. Per-class F1: background 0.9362, Johnson grass 0.6370, bindweed 0.6370, purslane 0.6237.

Dice.ambiguity: Dice loss used in training; Dice metric not reported.

PA.ambiguity: 'Acc.' column of Table 4 for UNet+EfficientNetB0 (D2); equals its Recall value in the table.

weed_F1.ambiguity: DERIVED mean of the three weed-species F1 values (0.6370 + 0.6370 + 0.6237)/3 = 0.6326; not directly reported as an aggregate weed F1.

crop_F1.ambiguity: No single crop class; dataset is weed-vs-background over bare/planted cotton field.

edge.device: None - offline (Google Colab cloud, NVIDIA T4 GPU 12 GB RAM)
edge.framework: Keras (Python), Adam optimizer lr 0.001, up to 100 epochs, early stopping (patience 10), focal loss + dice loss

fps.ambiguity: No inference speed/latency reported; trained on Google Colab NVIDIA T4 GPU.

issues: Headline metrics are for the multi-class 4-class task (3 weed species + background); binary weed/background task differs (best mIoU 0.6756, SegNet+DenseNet121).
weed_F1 is derived as the mean of the three weed-species F1s.
